requirements.requirement: The system must calculate years_in_practice as current_year minus graduation_year when graduation_year is present and valid.
The system must calculate years_in_practice as current_year minus enumeration_date.year when graduation_year is missing and enumeration_date is present.
The system must prioritize graduation_year over enumeration_date when both fields are present.
The system must return years_in_practice as null when both graduation_year and enumeration_date are missing.
The system must validate that graduation_year is less than or equal to the current year before using it in calculations.
The system must ignore graduation_year and fall back to enumeration_date when graduation_year is invalid (e.g., in the future or non-numeric).
The system must ignore enumeration_date and fall back to graduation_year when enumeration_date is invalid or malformed.
The system must ensure years_in_practice is not negative; if negative, it must be set to null.
The system must compute a normalized_experience_score based on years_in_practice using predefined deterministic ranges.
The system must assign a normalized_experience_score of null when years_in_practice is null.
The system must ensure normalized_experience_score falls within a bounded range of 0 to 1 inclusive.
The system must produce consistent years_in_practice outputs for identical inputs across multiple executions.
The system must handle enumeration_date values that include full timestamps by extracting only the year component.
The system must support graduation_year values provided as strings by converting them to integers before calculation.
